screen.rohostility.info.title: Reinterpretation of Hostility
screen.rohostility.info.unlock_hint_1: Enter the Nether or click below to activate the hostility system.
screen.rohostility.info.unlock_button: Step into the Cycle of Hostility
screen.rohostility.debug_editor.title: Debug Mob Editor
item.rohostility.sealed_item.desc: Temporarily sealed by Hostility; will restore shortly.
item.rohostility.debug_mob_editor.desc: Right-click air to configure, right-click hostile mob to respawn with overrides.
item.rohostility.debug_mob_editor.applie: Respawned mob with Lv.%s and %s traits.
command.rohostility.danger.set: Set danger points to %1$s for %2$s player(s).
command.rohostility.danger.add: Adjusted danger points by %1$s for %2$s player(s).
trait.rohostility.revive.desc: Revives once upon death with full HP, keeping level and traits.
trait.rohostility.regeneration.desc: Restores 0.1% max HP/tick if unharmed for 8 seconds.
trait.rohostility.adaptation.desc: Adapts to 1 damage type (-10% per hit, floored at 50%).
trait.rohostility.apocalypse.desc: 30% chance on hit to weaken 1 gear/Curio's attributes by 10% for 5s.
trait.rohostility.destruction.desc: 40% chance to strip 1 buff; otherwise +10% damage per buff.
trait.rohostility.unreality.desc: 40% chance on hit to lower a random enchantment by 1 for 10s (stacks).
trait.rohostility.fortitude.desc: Reduces incoming melee physical damage by 70%.
trait.rohostility.plunder.desc: 25% chance on hit to reduce max HP by 1% of final value for 20s (stacks).
trait.rohostility.berserker.desc: Below 50% HP: +10% ATK, +0.1 ATK SPD, +1 Reach, 0.1% HP/s regen.
trait.rohostility.seal.desc: 10% chance on hit to seal 1 random gear/Curio for 5 ticks.
trait.rohostility.armor_pierce.desc: 5% of attack damage becomes armor-piercing physical damage.
trait.rohostility.protection_pierce.desc: 5% of attack damage bypasses enchantments & effects (respects armor).
trait.rohostility.step_up.desc: Moves up any block height instantly without slowing down.
trait.rohostility.vitality.desc: Max HP +10 flat and +10% (heals to full on spawn).
trait.rohostility.anti_revive.desc: 50% chance on hit to apply Revive Prevention (8s), blocking Totems.
trait.rohostility.counterattack.desc: Deals 3 physical damage when hit (6s CD); triggers on-hit traits.
trait.rohostility.inspire.desc: Summons 3 Vexes every 20s; +5% ATK/SPD/Armor per active Vex.
trait.rohostility.poison_strike.desc: 50% chance on hit to inflict Poison I for 6s.
trait.rohostility.weakness_strike.desc: 50% chance on hit to inflict Wither I for 6s.
trait.rohostility.resentment.desc: 40% chance on hit to inflict Curse I for 8s (-50% healing).
trait.rohostility.ignite.desc: 45% chance on hit to set the target on fire for 4s.
trait.rohostility.pull.desc: Every 9s, pulls the target toward the owner with Knockback II velocity (ignores KB resistance).
trait.rohostility.repulse.desc: Every 9s, pushes the target away with Knockback II velocity (ignores KB resistance).
trait.rohostility.heavy.desc: Movement speed -15%, Knockback Resistance +0.3, Attack Damage +10%.
trait.rohostility.immunity.desc: 50% chance to reduce incoming debuff level by 1 (min Lv.1); caps debuff duration at 30s.
trait.rohostility.corrosion.desc: 30% chance on hit to subtract 1% Armor & 0.5% Toughness for 8s (stackable).
trait.rohostility.mental_disruption.desc: 40% chance on hit to subtract 1.5% L2 Magic Damage for 8s (stackable).
trait.rohostility.paralysis.desc: 35% chance on hit to subtract 1% Attack Damage for 8s (stackable).
trait.rohostility.ender.desc: Nullifies projectiles like an Enderman without teleporting.
trait.rohostility.illusion.desc: Displays 2 Illusioner-style visual decoys without turning invisible.
trait.rohostility.guardian_seal.desc: Every 40s in combat, summons 3 glowing level-scaled Zombies; -75% damage taken while any live.
